recipe.name: After Hours
recipe.description: A rich and decadent nightcap pairing dark rum and earthy coffee with creamy white chocolate and smooth cacao butter.
steps: Combine Bacardi Black, chilled coffee, white chocolate syrup, and melted cacao butter in a shaker.
Fill with ice and shake vigorously until well-chilled and frothy.
Double strain into a chilled coupe glass.
recipe.ice: Shaken with ice; served without ice
recipe.serving: Served straight up in a chilled coupe glass.
